title: "A module that was compiled using NumPy 1.x cannot be run in NumPy 2.x" and "_ARRAY_API not found" in ROS 2 cv_bridge: pip NumPy 2, OpenCV wheels and the fixes, measured
excerpt: Why apt cv_bridge breaks after pip pulls NumPy 2 (import error, segfault, or KeyError: 16 from OpenCV 5), which fixes worked (pip uninstall numpy, numpy<2 plus opencv-python-headless<4.12), and how Jazzy and Lyrical differ. Measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical.
